shortDescription: Manages configuration for an outgoing connection

options.name: description
options.description: The user-defined description of the transport config.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the transport config to manage.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to create transport-config object on.

options.name: profiles
options.description: Specifies a list of profiles for the outgoing connection to use to direct and manage traffic.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: rules
options.description: The iRules you want run on this transport config. iRules help automate the intercepting, processing, and routing of application traffic.

options.name: src_addr_translation
options.description: Specifies the type of source address translation enabled for the transport config and the pool the source address translation will use.

options.name: src_port
options.description: Specifies the source port for the connection being created. If no value is specified an ephemeral port is chosen for the connection being created. The acceptable range is between 0 and 65535 inclusive.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the transport-config object exists. When C(absent), ensures the transport-config object is removed.

options.name: type
options.description: Parameter used to specify the type of transport-config object to manage. Default setting is C(generic) with more options coming.
